role: Director, Department of Housing and Urban Development Area Office, Chicago
stance_basis: states awareness of no significantly harmful effect from temporary 4(f) land use, neither opposing nor strongly endorsing the project
summary: John L. Waner, Director of the HUD Area Office in Chicago, provided a brief comment during early coordination indicating no awareness of significantly harmful effects from the temporary use of Section 4(f) land west of Thorn Creek Bridge. His comment was noted in both the early coordination evaluation table and referenced in the draft environmental statement comments section. The agency preparer concurred with his assessment.
complaint_summary: Waner's office stated awareness of no significantly harmful effect from the temporary use of the Section 4(f) land west of Thorn Creek Bridge on the area.
